tools.name: get_match_prediction
tools.description: AI football prediction: combines the algorithm with live data, analyses the match in depth, and predicts the score. Returns win/draw/loss probabilities, confidence, Over/Under 2.5 and Both-Teams-To-Score. Keep those numbers in the answer. Team names must be English (Arsenal, not 阿森纳). Uses 1 credit

tools.name: get_account_credits
tools.description: Remaining Footalytics credits on the connected account. Call this before a prediction when the user asks about their quota, or when a prediction call failed with insufficient_credits.

tools.name: list_fixtures
tools.description: Upcoming football fixtures with fixture ids and a has_prediction flag (1 credit per successful call). Use it to discover matches, then call get_match_prediction with the fixture id or English team names.

tools.name: get_team
tools.description: Team profile from the Footalytics ratings table: current rating, games tracked and league (1 credit per successful call).

tools.name: list_results
tools.description: Settled official predictions with the real score and the grade — hit/miss per market and Brier score; the public accuracy record (1 credit per successful call).
